boot.name: Boot Sequence
boot.about: Grid draws in, a boot log types out, static burst, wordmark locks in (6 s)

boot.name: Signal
boot.about: TV static that thins out and leaves the wordmark behind (5 s)

boot.name: Grid Run
boot.about: Perspective grid runs at you, wordmark rises over the horizon (5 s)

suspend.name: Power Down
suspend.about: Old-CRT switch-off: collapses to a line, then a dot (2.4 s)

suspend.name: Static Out
suspend.about: Wordmark breaks into static, static rolls away to black (2.4 s)
